integrity: The theorem is proved analytically by exact minimization in one squared variable and a strict-convex supporting-line classification. Finite computation is supplemental only.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the two-variable case \(n=3\); the higher-dimensional chain \(n\ge4\) is not resolved.
No new maximal-correlation formula is asserted; the result concerns the deterministic quartic minimization problem isolated by the source.
A differently phrased or poorly indexed algebraic solution remains a residual literature risk despite targeted searches.
title: Exact two-variable classification for the Terrell-type quartic minimization problem
